class.name: SeedDown3D
class.brief_description: Plumed seeds (dandelion clocks, thistledown, willowherb fluff) loosed by the wind and carried by it.
class.description: Heads in seed near the camera (the scene's [VegetationField3D] species of [constant PlantGenerator.PRESET_DANDELION], [constant PlantGenerator.PRESET_THISTLE] and [constant PlantGenerator.PRESET_FIREWEED], found by their [code]plant_preset[/code] meta) loose seeds when a dry wind tugs them, in the season's share of heads in seed ([method PlantGenerator.get_bloom_shares]). Each seed rides the shared wind ([method WorldWeather.wind_at] at its height), falls at its falling speed (0.39 m/s for a dandelion, two to three times faster damp as the pappus closes) and is lifted and dropped by a random vertical gust (a Langevin model of the surface layer). Where it lands it is caught in the grass, lies on the ground or floats on water ([method WorldWater.flow_at] carries it), and a stronger gust lifts it again. Drawn as one [MultiMesh] of real geometry per kind, so the path tracer sees the same seeds.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the seeds [param seconds] in steps of 1/60 s without the scene (tests). With [param release], heads in seed loose seeds too.

method.name: clear_seeds
method.description: Removes every seed and resets [method get_released_count].

method.name: get_fall_speed
method.description: Falling speed of a dry seed of [param kind] in still air, m/s: 0.391 for the dandelion (measured, Cummins et al. 2018); the thistle's and willowherb's are estimates.

method.name: get_floating_count
method.description: Seeds that landed on open water and float on it.

method.name: get_kind_for_preset
method.description: The seed kind of a [enum PlantGenerator.Preset] (dandelion, thistle, fireweed), -1 for plants without plumed seeds.

method.name: get_lying_count
method.description: Seeds lying in the grass, on the ground or on water.

method.name: get_released_count
method.description: Seeds loosed since the last [method clear_seeds].

method.name: get_seed_states
method.description: Each live seed: x, y, z its position, w the seconds it has lain (negative aloft).

method.name: get_source_count
method.description: Heads of plumed-seed plants within [member range] at the last look (every 2 s, or [method refresh_sources]).

method.name: refresh_sources
method.description: Looks for the heads near the camera again now.

method.name: release_at
method.description: Looses [param count] seeds of [param kind] at [param position] now.

members.member: Seeds are loosed, stepped and drawn.
Seconds a seed lies before it is recycled (taken into the sward).
Wind 10 cm up (m/s) that lifts a lying seed out of the grass again.
Seeds kept at once; the oldest slot is reused.
Metres round the camera in which heads loose seeds; seeds past 1.5 times it are dropped.

Seeds a second one head in seed looses in a strong dry wind (an estimate); the season's share of heads in seed, the wind (from 2 to 10 m/s at the head), the surface wetness (half when wet) and rain (a tenth) scale it.
Stills: the seeds stay where they are (drawn, not stepped).
